description: LivePortrait expression/motion transfer: a reference face image + a driving video; the driving video's expression/pose is transferred onto the reference face.

best_for: face/expression/motion transfer from a driving video onto a reference face photo
avoid_for: full-body motion transfer (use a motion-transfer workflow)
text-to-video without a reference face (use ltx_23_t2v_distill)
selection_guidance.agent_hint: Prefer this when the user provides a face photo + a driving video and wants the photo to mimic the video's expression/pose. Requires --image (reference face) and --video (driving video).
